detail.abstract: This paper proposes a causal architecture connecting five elements of a culture built for sustained organizational change: three foundational postures-intellectual humility, trust, and bias toward action-that produce two emergent outcomespsychological safety and safe-to-try. It introduces the cultural change rate as a defined construct, models culture as a transmission network for tacit knowledge and wisdom, and argues that the cultural change rate is the binding constraint on organizational transformation. It extends the two-velocity sociotechnical tradition to four simultaneous rates of enterprise change and identifies six pairwise mismatches that culture must absorb. The framework is grounded in the existing empirical literature and in sustained practitioner observation across 25+ years of organizational leadership in an unusually wide range of business contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个因果架构，将"为持续组织变革而构建的文化"的五个要素联系起来：三个基础姿态（理智谦逊、信任、行动偏向）产生两个涌现结果（心理安全和安全试错）。论文引入"文化变革速率"作为定义性构念，将文化建模为隐性知识和智慧的传播网络，并论证文化变革速率是组织转型的约束条件。该框架将双速度社会技术传统拓展为四种企业变革速率，并识别出文化必须吸收的六对不匹配。
AI.research_question: 文化如何因果性地支撑持续的组织变革？文化变革速率如何成为组织转型的约束条件？
AI.motivation: 现有文献缺乏对支撑持续组织变革的文化要素之间因果关系的系统性架构，也缺少对文化变革速率作为组织转型约束的正式定义和论证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于组织文化理论、社会技术系统理论（双速度传统）、隐性知识传播理论，以及心理安全、理智谦逊、信任等组织行为学理论。
AI.method: 理论构建与概念性论文：基于现有实证文献的综合分析，并结合作者25年以上跨多样化商业情境的组织领导实践经验进行归纳。
AI.findings: ①三个基础姿态（理智谦逊、信任、行动偏向）因果性地产生两个涌现结果（心理安全和安全试错）；②文化变革速率是组织转型的约束因素；③将双速度社会技术模型扩展为四种速率，并识别出文化必须吸收的六对速率不匹配。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"文化变革速率"这一新的理论构念；将文化重新定义为隐性知识的传播网络；将社会技术系统的双速度传统拓展为四种速率框架；建立了文化要素间的因果架构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织领导者在构建持续变革文化方面提供了可操作的因果路径指导，帮助识别和诊断文化必须吸收的速率不匹配问题。

title: Beyond Interchange Caps Domestic and Cross-border Payments in an Era of Open Banking, Account-to-Account Payments, and Tokenised Money
affiliations: and Imperial College Business School

detail.title: Beyond Interchange Caps Domestic and Cross-border Payments in an Era of Open Banking, Account-to-Account Payments, and Tokenised Money
detail.abstract:
Interchange fee regulation has a coherent economic rationale. Card networks are two-sided
platforms; merchants may be unable to refuse widely held cards; collectively set default fees
are opaque; and high merchant charges can create transfers from users of low-cost payment
instruments to rewards-card users. Yet an interchange cap regulates only one price in a layered
system that can reprice through issuer account fees, rewards, acquiring margins, scheme and
processing fees, foreign-exchange spreads, or the terms on which new payment providers enter.
The paper’s new empirical anchor is Chemla et al. (2026), which studies two opposite
regulatory shocks at the same European issuer: a Swiss domestic cap imposed in November 2025
and the post-Brexit removal of European caps from UK–EEA card-not-present transactions in
October 2021. The targeted issuer price moves sharply in both directions and respects the legal
boundary of the intervention. The Swiss cap reduces the effective domestic rate by about 10.75
basis points and does not reprice adjacent corridors. The Brexit shock raises blended issuer
yield by about 55 percent at UK corridor exposure. Consumer incidence is not symmetric: the
Swiss revenue loss is followed by contraction of the free plan and migration toward paid plans,
while the Brexit gain produces no detectable change in spending per user, transactions per user,
or ticket size; aggregate acquisition remains too imprecisely estimated to resolve. A successful
regulatory first stage is therefore not a sufficient-statistic for consumer welfare.
The paper proposes a Payment Cost and Contestability Framework. Its core elements are
mandatory full-stack and corridor-level fee disclosure; rail-neutral access, steering, routing, and
data-portability rules; sustainable and consumer-protective account-to-account payment design;
direct instruments for financial inclusion; interoperable domestic and cross-border standards;
and functionally equivalent safeguards for tokenised deposits, stablecoins, and tokenised central-
bank settlement. A price cap remains available as a backstop, but only after a market-power,
pass-through, alternatives, incidence, and scope test, with anti-circumvention rules and review
tied to market contestability and the adjustment speed of the relevant margins.

AI.tldr: 本文研究银行卡交换费（interchange fee）监管的经济学逻辑。虽然交换费上限有理论依据，但仅规制单一定价在分层支付体系中可能被其他费用所替代。论文基于两项相反监管冲击的经验证据（瑞士国内交换费上限和英国脱欧后欧盟上限取消），发现价格在第一阶段确实移动，但消费者福利效应并不对称，提出"支付成本与可竞争性框架"作为更全面的监管方案。
AI.research_question: 交换费上限监管是否足以实现政策目标？在分层支付体系中，单一价格管制能否有效保护消费者福利？
AI.motivation: 交换费监管具有经济学理论基础，但现实中支付系统是多层级的，价格上限可能被其他费用调整所规避或抵消，需要经验证据和更全面的监管框架来评估其有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双边平台理论、交换费经济理论、监管经济学、支付系统可竞争性理论、消费者福利分析。
AI.method: 基于Chemla et al. (2026)的两项自然实验：瑞士国内市场交换费上限（2025年11月）和英国脱欧后欧盟上限取消（2021年10月），对同一欧洲发卡机构的定向价格变动、消费者行为（支出、交易量、票价规模、账户选择）进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 瑞士国内交换费上限使有效国内费率降低约10.75个基点，未引起邻近通道重新定价；脱欧冲击使英国通道的混合发卡收益增加约55%。但消费者影响不对称：瑞士收入损失导致免费计划收缩、用户转向付费计划，而脱欧收益未带来支出、交易量或票价规模的显著变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明监管第一阶段的成功（价格移动）不能作为消费者福利的充分统计量（sufficient statistic）；提出"支付成本与可竞争性框架"（Payment Cost and Contestability Framework）作为新的理论分析视角，将监管视野从单一价格扩展到整个支付系统的可竞争性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出全面的支付监管改革方案，包括全栈费用披露、轨道中立接入与路由规则、可持续的账户间支付设计、普惠金融直接工具、互操作性标准、代币化资产监管等；价格上限仅作为后备工具并附加多重前置测试。

title: "Can I Talk to a Human?": Queue Design to Influence Channel Choice in Customer-Service Interactions
affiliations: Tsinghua University - Tsinghua University School of Economics and Management, University of Texas at Dallas - Naveen Jindal School of Management and University of Texas at Dallas - Naveen Jindal School of Management

detail.title: "Can I Talk to a Human?": Queue Design to Influence Channel Choice in Customer-Service Interactions
detail.abstract: Many customer service systems now operate both AI and human channels. We study such a dual-channel service system, in which customers receive private, noisy signals about their request type (simple or complex) and choose a channel. Truly complex requests attempted by AI eventually fail and must transfer to the human channel. The service provider's objective function is average sojourn time; ideally, it would route simple-signal requests to AI to avoid congesting the human channel, and complex-signal requests to the human channel to avoid the higher chance of wasted time on AI failure. However, the provider does not know customers' signals. Nevertheless, it can use queue design to influence customers' self-interested channel choices toward socially preferable outcomes. To that end, we propose the prioritize-transfer, delay-direct mechanism, an easily implementable queue design that rewards customers who try AI. Post-AI-failure transfers to the human channel are with some probability placed in a priority queue. Direct-to-human customers are placed in the lower-priority queue and also experience a fixed amount of extra delay beyond the necessary queueing time. We show that there always exists a prioritize-transfer, delay-direct mechanism that optimally solves the provider's problem. Moreover, under intermediate AI failure time, we show that the prioritize-transfer mechanism (the special case without extra direct-to-human delay) even manages to achieve the first-best outcome, i.e., the minimum sojourn time achievable by a provider who knows all customer signals and controls routing. We also obtain insights on the increase in average sojourn time caused by customer choice and private information.

AI.tldr: 本文研究同时提供AI和人工渠道的双渠道客户服务系统。客户收到关于其请求类型（简单或复杂）的私有、有噪声信号并自主选择渠道。服务提供商设计了一种"优先转移-延迟直连"（prioritize-transfer, delay-direct）队列机制，通过奖励尝试AI的客户（AI失败后转移时有一定概率进入优先队列）和惩罚直接选择人工渠道的客户（进入低优先级队列并承受额外固定延迟），来引导客户做出对社会最优的选择。该机制总能最优解决提供商的问题，且在中等AI失败时间下，还能实现"第一最佳"（first-best）结果。
AI.research_question: 在双渠道（AI与人工）服务系统中，服务提供商如何在无法获知客户私有信号的情况下，通过队列设计来引导自利的客户做出社会最优的渠道选择，从而最小化平均逗留时间？
AI.motivation: 现代客户服务系统同时运营AI和人工渠道，这是一个日益普遍的现实场景。由于客户拥有关于自身请求类型的私有信息（简单或复杂），且AI处理复杂请求会失败并需转移至人工渠道，服务提供商面临信息不对称下的渠道分配问题。提供商无法直接观测客户信号，但可以通过队列设计影响客户的自利选择，从而促使系统效率接近或达到最优。
AI.theoretical_framework: 排队博弈理论（queueing game theory）；信息经济学中的私有信号与机制设计；双渠道服务系统的路由与调度优化；激励相容的队列优先权设计。
AI.method: 本文采用排队论与博弈论相结合的分析方法。构建了双渠道服务系统的排队模型，设计了"优先转移-延迟直连"机制，通过数学推导证明该机制的最优性，并分析了在中间AI失败时间条件下达到第一最佳结果的充分条件。
AI.findings: （1）总是存在一个"优先转移-延迟直连"机制能够最优解决提供商的问题；（2）在AI失败时间处于中间水平时，"优先转移"机制（没有额外延迟的特例）甚至能达到第一最佳（first-best）结果，即与拥有全部客户信号并控制路由的提供商所能达到的最小逗留时间相同；（3）获得了关于客户选择和私有信息所导致的平均逗留时间增加的定量洞见。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出了"优先转移-延迟直连"这一新颖的队列设计机制，为双渠道服务系统的激励设计提供了理论框架；（2）证明了在特定条件下，即使存在信息不对称，简单机制也能实现信息完整时的最优结果（第一最佳），拓展了排队博弈中机制设计的边界；（3）刻画了客户自利选择与私有信息的社会成本。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为实际客户服务系统提供了易于实施的队列设计方案——"优先转移-延迟直连"，该机制不需要提供商获知客户私有信号即可实施；（2）提供了关于如何通过奖励AI尝试者和适度惩罚直接走人工渠道客户来优化系统效率的操作性指导；（3）帮助服务提供商理解客户选择与信息不对称带来的效率损失，从而在AI与人工渠道的资源配置上做出更明智的决策。

title: Linking Funding Mechanisms in Off-Chain Perpetual Futures to the DeFi Leverage Cycle

detail.title: Linking Funding Mechanisms in Off-Chain Perpetual Futures to the DeFi Leverage Cycle

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract: Little work has been done to potentially explain relations between funding rates of perpetual futures in the centralized exchange (CEX) and the broader DeFi leverage cycle. We construct a new funding rate-derived metric called “Sign-Aware Time to Zero Funding” (SATZeF) as a candidate for an off-chain regime indicator of onchain leverage, proxied by liquidation volumes. Through empirical observations of lending activity on Aave v3 Mainnet and funding rate time-series on Kraken (CEX), we show that the SATZeF serves as a reliable off-chain regime indicator of the DeFi ecosystem’s current state with respect to the leverage cycle, while daily funding rates can better explain granular movements in on-chain liquidation volumes. From a macro-policy standpoint, this paves the way for greater insight into potentially enforcing leverage requirements on CEXs as a means of indirectly affecting funding conditions in DeFi lending pools.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个新的基于资金费率导出的指标"Sign-Aware Time to Zero Funding"(SATZeF)，作为DeFi链上杠杆（以清算量代理）的链下制度指标。通过观察Aave v3主网的借贷活动和Kraken交易所的资金费率时间序列，证明SATZeF是DeFi生态系统杠杆周期的可靠链下制度指标，而每日资金费率能更好地解释链上清算量的细粒度变动。
AI.research_question: 中心化交易所（CEX）永续合约的资金费率与更广泛的DeFi杠杆周期之间存在怎样的关系？SATZeF指标能否作为DeFi链上杠杆的链下制度指标？
AI.motivation: 目前很少有研究解释CEX永续合约资金费率与DeFi杠杆周期之间的关系，缺乏一个能够连接链下交易信号与链上借贷杠杆状态的指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资金费率理论（funding rate）、DeFi杠杆周期理论、清算机制理论
AI.method: 构建新的资金费率衍生指标SATZeF（Sign-Aware Time to Zero Funding），结合Aave v3主网的借贷活动数据和Kraken交易所的资金费率时间序列进行实证分析。
AI.findings: SATZeF能作为DeFi生态系统中杠杆周期的可靠链下制度指标；每日资金费率能更好地解释链上清算量的细粒度变动。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次建立了CEX资金费率与DeFi链上杠杆周期之间的系统性联系，提出了SATZeF这一新的理论指标，拓展了DeFi杠杆周期研究的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 从宏观政策角度，为监管机构提供了一个新的视角——通过CEX杠杆要求的执行来间接影响DeFi借贷池中的资金条件，为跨市场风险管理和政策制定提供参考。

reference: Harvard Art Law Review, Volume 1, No. 1, Pp. 192-199
title: Idols In Exile: India’s Art Law And The Global Fight For Cultural Restitution

detail.title: Idols In Exile: India’s Art Law And The Global Fight For Cultural Restitution

publicationDetails.detailsText: Harvard Art Law Review, Volume 1, No. 1, Pp. 192-199

detail.abstract: The review examines S. Vijay Kumar’s The Idol Thief as a lens through which to assess India’s legal and institutional response to the illicit trafficking and restitution of cultural antiquities. It situates Kumar’s account of the Subhash Kapoor network within the broader intersection of property law, provenance, international cultural-property regimes, and the global antiquities market. The review evaluates the limitations of India’s existing framework, particularly the Antiquities and Art Treasures Act, 1972, highlighting weaknesses in registration, provenance verification, enforcement capacity, and international coordination. It further considers the tension between cultural nationalism and cultural internationalism and the ethical responsibilities of museums, auction houses, collectors, and intermediary institutions. Against this backdrop, the review examines recent Indian efforts towards repatriation, digitised heritage documentation, bilateral cooperation, and the growing role of civil-society initiatives such as the India Pride Project. It argues that restitution cannot remain a predominantly reactive, diplomatic exercise and calls for a more comprehensive framework combining stronger domestic enforcement, mandatory provenance due diligence, technological tracking, international cooperation, and meaningful reintegration of recovered artefacts into their cultural communities. Ultimately, the review frames cultural restitution not merely as the recovery of objects, but as a question of sovereignty, identity, cultural memory, and justice.

AI.tldr: 本文以S. Vijay Kumar的《The Idol Thief》为切入点，系统评估印度在文化遗产非法贩运与返还方面的法律与制度回应，指出当前框架（尤其是1972年《古物与艺术珍品法》）在登记、来源验证、执法能力与国际协调方面的不足，主张返还不应仅是消极的外交行为，而需建立综合框架，涵盖国内执法强化、强制性来源尽职调查、技术追踪、国际合作及文物的社会文化重新融入。
AI.research_question: 印度的法律与制度框架在应对文化遗产非法贩运与返还方面存在哪些局限？如何构建更全面、主动的文化返还框架？
AI.motivation: 以Subhash Kapoor文物走私网络案例为镜鉴，揭示印度现行文化遗产保护与返还机制的深层缺陷，并超越单纯的法律分析，从主权、身份、文化记忆与正义等维度重新思考文化返还的本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产权理论与来源学（property law & provenance）、国际文化财产制度（international cultural-property regimes）、文化民族主义与文化国际主义之间的张力、文化遗产伦理（博物馆、拍卖行、收藏家及中介机构的责任）
AI.method: 书评/批判性文献综述，结合案例叙事（Subhash Kapoor网络）与制度分析（印度1972年《古物与艺术珍品法》等）进行多维度评估。
AI.findings: 印度现行法律框架在文物登记、来源验证、执法能力与国际协调方面存在显著薄弱环节；返还工作仍以被动、外交式为主；近年出现的数字化遗产档案、双边合作及公民社会倡议（如India Pride Project）展现积极趋势，但尚不足以形成系统性的解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 将文化返还从"追回物品"的技术性议题提升为主权、身份、文化记忆与正义的多维理论命题，丰富并批判了文化民族主义与文化国际主义之间的理论对话。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及类似国家提供政策建议：强化国内执法、推行强制性来源尽职调查、引入技术化追踪手段、深化国际合作，并强调被返还文物需真正回归其文化社区以实现社会文化意义上的再融入。

title: Thought as the Deadliest Weapon: A Theoretical Study of Cognitive Origination in Strategic Conflict A Philosophical and Comparative-literary Analysis

detail.title: Thought as the Deadliest Weapon: A Theoretical Study of Cognitive Origination in Strategic Conflict A Philosophical and Comparative-literary Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval and informed consent were not required because the study is conceptual and literary-comparative and does not involve human participants, personal data, patients or animals.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This theoretical study examines sustained strategic cognitive commitment: a settled intention, orientation, or plan capable of being channelled through communication, organization, doctrine, technology, or action. It does not claim that ordinary thought is statistically more lethal than physical weapons. Its narrower claim is that deliberate strategic cognition can precede, organize, and outlast material instruments of conflict. Through conceptual analysis and qualified comparative readings of traditions associated with Kautilya/Chanakya and Shakuni, the study advances an eleven-property taxonomy, an antecedent-to-channelization heuristic, a lifecycle distinction between the transformation ('recycling') and recurrence ('resurfacing') of unresolved destructive intention, and testable propositions for later comparative research. It also places destructive cognition within a balanced generative account: thought, when converted into collective commitment and action, may construct, transform, destroy, or restore institutions and historical trajectories. The proposed contribution is the specific synthesis and application of these elements, not a claim that their underlying ideas lack precedent. The author-proposed, non-clinical remedy architecture matches preventive, corrective, and restorative interventions to the stage, theatre, and pathway of externalized intention, with safeguards against coercive forgiveness, victim-blaming, censorship, and punishment of private thought. The analysis yields conceptual findings and propositions rather than empirical effect estimates; systematic prior-art review and comparative or empirical validation remain necessary before stronger causal or effectiveness claims can be made.

AI.tldr: 本文是一项理论研究，考察"持续战略认知承诺"——一种能够通过沟通、组织、教义、技术或行动传导的坚定意图、取向或计划。研究提出十一属性分类法、前因—渠道化启发式、生命周期区分（"回收"与"重现"），并通过概念分析及对考底利耶/恰纳卡亚和沙库尼传统的比较阅读，构建了可检验的研究命题。作者明确承认这不是对经验效应的估计，而是概念性发现与命题的综合与运用。
AI.research_question: 深思熟虑的战略认知如何在冲突中先于、组织并超越物质工具发挥作用？破坏性意图的持续承诺具有哪些属性、如何被渠道化、以及如何在其生命周期中转化或重现？
AI.motivation: 现有研究往往将思想视为附属于物质力量，或者缺乏对"战略性认知承诺"这一持久现象的系统和理论化分析。本文旨在通过概念综合，为理解认知在冲突中独立于且超越物质武器的角色提供更平衡的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概念分析法；考底利耶/恰纳卡亚与沙库尼传统的比较阅读框架；十一属性分类法；前因—渠道化启发式；破坏性意图的生命周期理论（回收与重现）
AI.method: 理论研究，采用概念分析和限定性比较阅读，辅以作者提出的非临床补救架构
AI.findings: 提出了十一属性分类法、前因到渠道化的启发式框架、区分"回收"（转化）与"重现"（复现）的生命周期概念，以及后续比较研究的可检验命题；还设计了与外部化意图的阶段、场域和路径相匹配的预防性、纠正性和修复性干预架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了破坏性认知的生成性理论框架，说明思想转化为集体承诺和行动后能建构、转化、摧毁或修复制度与历史轨迹；通过十一属性分类法和生命周期区分丰富了战略认知理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出非临床性的补救架构，将预防性、纠正性和修复性干预与外部化意图的阶段、场域和路径匹配，同时防范强制性宽恕、受害者责备、审查和惩罚私人思想等风险。

title: How AI Changes What we can do with English: Surface Fluency and Silent Cultural Adjustment in Multilingual Communication

detail.title: How AI Changes What we can do with English: Surface Fluency and Silent Cultural Adjustment in Multilingual Communication

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This article is conceptual and does not report human-subject research.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this work.

detail.abstract:
For those who use English as an additional language, generative AI is changing the relationship between the English they have personally acquired and the English they can produce and use in communication. Multilingual users can now move ideas across languages and express them in fluent, professionally valued English with unprecedented speed and autonomy. This change may widen access to English-dominant academic, professional, and social spaces. It also creates less visible communicative risks.

This article proposes two concepts for understanding these risks: surface fluency and silent cultural adjustment. Surface fluency arises when the linguistic performance displayed by an AI-assisted message exceeds what the user can adequately understand, assess, explain, or carry forward as their own communication. Silent cultural adjustment arises when AI changes the stance, certainty, commitment, authority, relational positioning, or expected action expressed by a message without the user recognising and consciously choosing that shift. To address these risks, the article proposes user-centred calibration of AI-assisted messages, guided by three criteria: users should be able to Understand, Own, and Explain the messages they use as their own communication.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了生成式AI如何改变英语非母语使用者的语言关系，提出了"表面流畅性"和"无声文化调整"两个概念来描述AI辅助沟通中存在的隐性风险，并提出了以"理解、拥有、解释"三原则为核心的用户中心校准框架。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何改变英语非母语使用者的沟通方式？AI辅助沟通中存在的隐性风险是什么？如何应对这些风险？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI使英语非母语者能够以前所未有的速度和自主性将想法跨语言转换并表达为流畅的英语，这虽拓宽了进入英语主导学术、职业和社会空间的机会，但也带来了不易察觉的沟通风险，需要被识别和应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出两个核心概念：表面流畅性（surface fluency）和无声文化调整（silent cultural adjustment），以及用户中心校准框架（User-centred calibration）下的三个标准：理解（Understand）、拥有（Own）、解释（Explain）。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文，通过提出分析性概念和规范性框架来理解生成式AI辅助沟通中的风险。
AI.findings: 表面流畅性指AI辅助信息所展示的语言表现超越了用户能充分理解、评估、解释或承接为自身沟通的能力；无声文化调整指AI在用户未认知和自觉选择的情况下改变了信息所表达的立场、确定性、承诺度、权威性、关系定位或预期行动。为应对这些风险，应遵循理解、拥有、解释三项标准进行用户中心校准。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"表面流畅性"和"无声文化调整"两个新概念，为理解生成式AI时代多语言使用者的沟通风险提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI辅助沟通工具的开发者、使用者和教育者提供了可操作的三项校准标准（理解、拥有、解释），有助于减少AI辅助沟通中的隐性风险。

title: Past Exposure, Future Innovation: CEO Board Experience and AI Innovation
affiliations: University of Southampton, University of Southampton, University of Southampton and University of Southampton

detail.title: Past Exposure, Future Innovation: CEO Board Experience and AI Innovation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Why do otherwise similar firms differ in their ability to convert technological opportunities into innovation? This paper studies whether one explanation lies in CEO prior exposure to innovation at other firms where they previously served on boards. Linking BoardEx employment histories to USPTO AI patents, we construct grant-based measures of CEO external AI innovation exposure. Firms led by CEO with greater external AI innovation exposure subsequently produce more AI Innovation, robust to firm, CEO and industry-year controls, and the relation is specific to AI rather than general patenting. Event studies around CEO turnover, comparing firms with similar pre-turnover innovation potential, show that the arrival of exposed CEO is followed by increases in both AI Innovation Filings and AI Innovation, with no evidence of pre-existing filing trends. The effect is stronger in firms with greater absorptive capacity, and exposed insider and outsider CEO transitions have similar effects. Exposed CEO are also associated with the reallocation of AI inventors to the firm, including from firms on whose boards they previously served, and give rise to first-time AI inventors at the firm. The findings show that technology-specific CEO exposure is a form of managerial human capital that helps firms transform frontier technological opportunities into realized innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，CEO在以往任职的董事会中接触外部AI创新的经历，能够显著提升其所在企业后续的AI创新能力。这种效应在具有较强吸收能力的企业中更为显著，且通过吸引AI发明人（包括来自其曾任职董事会企业的人才）和培育企业内部首批AI发明人来实现。
AI.research_question: 为什么看似相似的企业在将技术机会转化为创新成果的能力上存在差异？CEO先前在其他公司董事会任职时所接触的外部创新经验是否是原因之一？
AI.motivation: 尽管企业创新能力的差异是管理学和组织理论的核心问题，但已有研究较少关注CEO通过外部董事会任职所获得的技术特定（technology-specific）人力资本对企业创新的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 管理人力资本理论；吸收能力理论（absorptive capacity）
AI.method: 将BoardEx就业历史与美国专利商标局（USPTO）AI专利数据匹配，构建基于授权专利的CEO外部AI创新暴露度指标；采用企业、CEO和行业-年份固定效应的回归分析，利用CEO更替事件进行事件研究比较。
AI.findings: （1）CEO外部AI创新暴露度高的企业随后产出更多AI创新，且该关系具有AI特定性而非一般专利性；（2）CEO更替事件研究表明，有暴露经历的CEO上任后AI创新申请和授权显著增加，且不存在预先趋势；（3）效应在吸收能力更强的企业中更显著；（4）内部和外部继任CEO的效应相似；（5）有暴露经历的CEO会促使AI发明人（包括来自其曾任职董事会的企业）重新配置至本企业，并催生企业首批AI发明人。
AI.theory_contributions: 将CEO人力资本的概念拓展至技术特定维度，展示了外部董事会经历作为管理人力资本的一种形式如何帮助企业在技术前沿识别和吸收机会并转化为实际创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业董事会在CEO选拔和继任规划中考虑候选人的创新履历与外部技术视角提供了依据；也提示企业可通过董事会网络获取前沿技术知识，增强组织吸收能力。

title: Do You Have My Size In Stock? Assortment and Inventory Optimization Under the Consider-Fit-Then-Choose Choice Model
affiliations: , , UCLA Anderson School of Management and Washington University in St. Louis - John M. Olin Business School

detail.title: Do You Have My Size In Stock? Assortment and Inventory Optimization Under the Consider-Fit-Then-Choose Choice Model
detail.abstract:
In apparel retail and other applications, when a customer's preferred size is unavailable, demand may shift to nearby sizes. This substitution creates new assortment and inventory optimization challenges because product availability---and, consequently, demand---becomes coupled across sizes. To address these challenges, we introduce the consider-fit-then-choose (CFTC) model, a simple yet rich framework for capturing size-dependent choice behavior. The model applies to settings in which each product may be offered in multiple sizes and the set of available sizes directly affects both customer preferences and consideration sets through a notion of fit, measured by the distance between an available size and the customer's ideal size. Under this model, we study both assortment optimization and the show-all inventory selection problem, in which the retailer chooses initial inventory levels before the selling horizon and subsequently offers every in-stock product to each arriving customer.

We first show that assortment optimization under the CFTC model is NP-hard and develop a polynomial-time approximation scheme (PTAS) when customers are willing to deviate by at most $O(1)$ sizes from their ideal size. Combined with the recent black-box framework of Fu et al. (2026), this result yields a nearly 0.272-approximation for the corresponding show-all inventory selection problem. We then ask whether stronger guarantees can be obtained by exploiting the specific choice dynamics of the CFTC model. Our approach to both the fluid and stochastic versions of the inventory problem begins by stocking only every other size, thereby decoupling demand across the stocked sizes. Under this restriction, the CFTC model reduces to a special class of mixed multinomial logit models, which we prove satisfies the convex chain decomposition (CCD) property introduced by Goyal et al. (2023). This property allows us to translate solutions to a classical choice-based linear program into feasible show-all inventory policies.

Building on this structure, for the fluid problem we develop a polynomial-time (1/2-ε)-approximation algorithm under adjacent-size substitution and a mild condition on the preference weights. For the stochastic problem, we establish an asymptotic 1/2-approximation guarantee using a new coupling argument that connects the stochastic inventory process to its fluid counterpart. Numerical experiments on instances calibrated using footwear data demonstrate that our inventory solutions achieve small optimality gaps across a broad range of substitution patterns and problem settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出考虑-适配-再选择（CFTC）模型来描述服装零售中因尺码缺货而引发的跨尺码需求替代行为，研究在该模型下的品类优化和展示所有尺码的库存选择问题。作者证明了品类优化是NP难的，并开发了近似算法；通过利用CFTC模型的选择动态特性，分别针对流体和随机库存问题开发了1/2近似算法，并用鞋类数据验证了算法的实用性。
AI.research_question: 在服装零售等场景中，当顾客偏好的尺码缺货时，需求会转移到相邻尺码。这种替代行为导致产品可用性与需求跨尺码耦合。本文的核心研究问题是：在此类环境下，如何进行品类优化和初始库存水平决策（show-all inventory selection problem）？
AI.motivation: 服装零售中尺码缺货引发的跨尺码需求替代是一个普遍存在的现实问题，但传统的品类优化和库存管理模型通常假设产品之间需求独立。当产品以多尺码形式提供且可用尺码集合影响顾客偏好和考虑集时，需求耦合给优化带来了新的挑战，需要新的模型和算法来应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文的理论框架包括：1) CFTC（consider-fit-then-choose）模型：用可用尺码与顾客理想尺码之间的距离（fit）来刻画偏好和考虑集；2) 混合多项Logit（mixed multinomial logit）模型；3) 凸链分解（CCD, convex chain decomposition）性质；4) 基于选择的线性规划（choice-based linear program）。
AI.method: 1) 证明CFTC模型下品类优化是NP难的，并开发多项式时间近似方案（PTAS）；2) 通过只库存每隔一个尺码的策略来解耦需求，将CFTC模型化简为特殊类别的混合多项Logit模型，并证明其满足CCD性质；3) 对流体问题开发(1/2-ε)近似算法；4) 对随机问题通过耦合论证建立渐近1/2近似保证；5) 使用鞋类数据开展数值实验验证。
AI.findings: 1) 品类优化在CFTC模型下是NP难的，但在顾客最多偏离O(1)个尺码时有PTAS；2) 结合Fu et al. (2026)的黑箱框架可得到约0.272近似的show-all库存选择问题解；3) 通过间隔库存策略，CFTC模型可化为满足CCD性质的混合MNLOGIT模型；4) 流体问题有(1/2-ε)近似算法（在相邻尺码替代和温和偏好权重条件下）；5) 随机问题有渐近1/2近似保证；6) 基于鞋类数据的数值实验显示在各种替代模式和设置下最优性差距很小。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出CFTC模型，首次系统刻画了尺码依赖的替代选择行为；2) 建立了CFTC模型与混合多项Logit模型及CCD性质之间的理论联系，为利用基于选择的线性规划开发库存策略提供了新途径；3) 开发了新的耦合论证，将随机库存过程与流体对应问题联系起来，为随机库存问题提供逼近保证。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为服装零售商提供了可计算的多项式时间算法，在现实约束下（如顾客最多偏离几个尺码）可获得接近最优的品类和库存决策；2) 通过鞋类数据验证了算法在实际场景中的有效性，帮助零售商在尺码缺货情境下做出更优的品类和库存决策，减少需求流失。

title: Strengthening Supply Chain Resilience through Data-Driven Recall Risk Management

detail.title: Strengthening Supply Chain Resilience through Data-Driven Recall Risk Management

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests and takes full responsibility for the integrity of the data and the accuracy of the data analysis.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, human tissue, or personally identifiable information. All applicable ethical standards have been followed.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was conducted independently by the author and was not sponsored, funded, or supported by the author's employer or any other organization.

detail.abstract: Medical device recalls often pose significant risks to patient safety, operational continuity, and financial sustainability. Managing these events at the intersection of Cost, Quality, and Outcomes (CQO) requires rapid reactive response and structured proactive risk assessment. Although alerts/recalls platforms are widely adopted, recall management remains largely fragmented, causing administrative latency, delayed item tracing, inconsistent patient impact assessment, and prolonged exposure to affected products. This paper introduces a scalable, data-driven framework transitioning healthcare operations from unstructured crisis response to a hybrid resilience model that balances effective reactive protocols with proactive risk-mitigation pathways. The framework is designed to integrate structural recall intake with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Electronic Medical Record (EMR) data using the Unique Device Identifier (UDI) to enable rapid item-and lot-level tracing, and patient-level visibility. Concurrently, it introduces a quantitative risk-scoring methodology-incorporating clinical severity, historical recall patterns and traceability-to identify high-risk products proactively, prioritize active recalls, and drive supply chain strategy. Furthermore, we explore the role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in automating recall data extraction, normalizing product identifiers, strengthening data governance, and enhancing dashboarding capabilities. Existing literature correlates recall response efficiency with clinical outcomes-including Length of Stay (LOS) and revision rates-and financial metrics such as recoverable asset value and uncompensated procedural costs. By enhancing response efficiency and enabling proactive mitigation, this framework provides a scalable blueprint for strengthening compliance with evolving federal quality mandates while reducing the national burden associated with recalled medical products and supply chain disruptions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可扩展的数据驱动框架，将医疗设备召回管理从无结构的危机响应转变为混合韧性模型，通过整合UDI、ERP和EMR数据实现快速追溯与患者级可见性，并引入定量风险评分方法以主动识别高风险产品，同时探索AI在自动化数据提取和治理中的作用。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个可扩展的、数据驱动的医疗设备召回管理框架，以实现从被动危机响应向主动风险缓解的混合韧性模型转变？
AI.motivation: 医疗设备召回给患者安全、运营连续性和财务可持续性带来重大风险；现有召回管理高度碎片化，导致行政延迟、物品追溯滞后、患者影响评估不一致以及暴露时间延长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合韧性模型（平衡反应性协议与主动性风险缓解路径）、CQO（成本、质量、结果）交叉管理框架、结构性召回摄入与UDI数据治理
AI.method: 提出一个集成框架，整合UDI（唯一设备标识符）与ERP和EMR数据以实现快速物品和批次级追溯及患者级可见性；引入包含临床严重程度、历史召回模式和可追溯性的定量风险评分方法；并探索AI在召回数据提取、产品标识符规范化、数据治理和仪表板功能中的应用。
AI.findings: 该框架通过提升响应效率和实现主动缓解，提供可扩展的蓝图以增强对联邦质量要求的合规性，并减少召回医疗产品和供应链中断带来的国家负担。现有文献表明召回响应效率与临床结果（如住院时长和翻修率）及财务指标（如可回收资产价值和未补偿的程序成本）相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将召回管理从碎片化的被动响应转向混合韧性模型的理论构建，将反应性协议与主动性风险缓解相结合；提出了整合临床、历史和追溯性维度的定量风险评分方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗机构提供可扩展的召回管理蓝图，包括利用UDI集成ERP/EMR实现快速追溯、AI驱动的自动化数据提取与治理、主动识别高风险产品以指导供应链策略，以及增强对联邦质量法规的合规性。

title: Trade Diversion through the Eurasian Economic Union: Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan as Conduits for Sanctioned Russian Trade

detail.title: Trade Diversion through the Eurasian Economic Union: Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan as Conduits for Sanctioned Russian Trade
detail.abstract: In February 2022, the Russian invasion of Ukraine triggered one of the biggest sanctions campaigns in modern history. The measures were designed to isolate Russia from foreign technology and finance, but in the two Central Asian countries most closely linked to the Russian economy, trade increased. This paper seeks to assess the extent to which a re-export boom affected these two economies, and the extent to which it simply transferred them from trade reliance on Russia to reliance on China. This paper, based on published statistics and existing research, concludes that the longer-lasting impact was a deepening of Chinese economic influence that neither government fully chose. The gains were not maintained after Russia closed the tariff loopholes in 2024, when Kyrgyz vehicle re-exports dropped by about 85 percent. Kazakhstan, with Western energy investment to protect, has strengthened export restrictions. In contrast, Kyrgyzstan, which has no such limitation, maximised the trade.

AI.tldr: 本文评估2022年俄乌战争后西方对俄制裁引发的再出口热潮对中亚两国（吉尔吉斯斯坦和哈萨克斯坦）经济的影响，发现其长期后果是深化了中国经济影响力，而这种影响并非两国政府完全自主选择的结果。
AI.research_question: 制裁引发的再出口热潮在多大程度上影响了吉尔吉斯斯坦和哈萨克斯坦两国经济？它在多大程度上只是将两国从对俄贸易依赖转移为对华依赖？
AI.motivation: 2022年2月俄罗斯入侵乌克兰引发了现代史上最大规模的制裁运动之一，旨在将俄罗斯与外国技术和金融隔离，但与俄罗斯经济联系最紧密的两个中亚国家的贸易却出现增长，需要评估这一再出口热潮的真实经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贸易转移与制裁规避的国际贸易理论框架。
AI.method: 基于公开发布的统计数据和现有文献的定性分析。
AI.findings: 长期影响是中国经济影响力的深化，这并非两国政府完全自愿的选择；2024年俄罗斯关闭关税漏洞后吉尔吉斯斯坦车辆再出口下降约85%，收益未能维持；哈萨克斯坦因有西方能源投资需要保护而加强了出口限制，吉尔吉斯斯坦则无此类限制而最大化贸易。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了制裁规避的再出口热潮可能产生非预期后果，即深化第三国（中国）的经济影响力，而非仅仅是贸易转移。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解制裁政策的地缘经济效应提供了中亚案例证据，对政策制定者评估制裁的溢出效应具有参考价值。

title: Drivers of Green Supply Chain Management Adoption in Egyptian Manufacturing: A Reproducible Synthetic-Data Validation Study

detail.title: Drivers of Green Supply Chain Management Adoption in Egyptian Manufacturing: A Reproducible Synthetic-Data Validation Study
detail.abstract: This computational research article evaluates an integrated model of green supply chain management (GSCM) adoption using a reproducible synthetic dataset of 450 firm-level cases calibrated to an Egyptian manufacturing research context. Six antecedents-external pressure, organizational readiness, human capability, digital readiness, supplier collaboration, and logistics-ecosystem readiness-were generated from a correlated latent structure and linked to GSCM adoption and three performance outcomes. Reliability estimates ranged from 0.78 to 0.82. The adoption model explained 51.5% of variance; all six drivers were positive and statistically distinguishable from zero in the synthetic benchmark. GSCM adoption was strongly associated with environmental performance (β=0.57), operational performance (β=0.49), and resilience (β=0.46). The results demonstrate model identifiability, expected-sign recovery, and the feasibility of a future empirical test. They do not constitute evidence about actual Egyptian manufacturers.

AI.tldr: 本文使用可复现的合成数据集（450个企业案例，校准至埃及制造业情境）评估绿色供应链管理（GSCM）采纳的综合模型。六个前因变量均与GSCM采纳显著正相关，模型解释了51.5%的方差；GSCM采纳与环境绩效（β=0.57）、运营绩效（β=0.49）和韧性（β=0.46）显著相关。研究验证了模型的可识别性和预期符号恢复，为未来实证检验奠定基础，但结果不构成对埃及制造业实际状况的证据。
AI.research_question: 综合绿色供应链管理采纳模型是否具有可识别性，能否在合成数据中恢复预期的变量间关系，从而为未来在埃及制造业情境中的实证检验奠定基础？
AI.motivation: GSCM采纳研究面临数据获取困难、样本不足等问题，作者通过构建可复现的合成数据集来评估综合模型的统计性能，验证模型的可识别性和预期符号恢复能力，为未来真正的实证研究提供方法论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合绿色供应链管理（GSCM）采纳模型，涵盖六个前因变量：外部压力、组织准备度、人力能力、数字准备度、供应商协作和物流生态系统准备度，并关联三种绩效结果（环境绩效、运营绩效、韧性）。
AI.method: 计算仿真方法：基于相关潜在结构生成450个企业层面的合成案例数据集，校准至埃及制造业研究情境；采用结构方程建模评估模型，检验信度估计（0.78-0.82）、方差解释率和路径系数的统计显著性。
AI.findings: （1）六个驱动因素均与GSCM采纳正相关且在统计上显著区别于零；（2）采纳模型解释了51.5%的方差；（3）GSCM采纳与环境绩效（β=0.57）、运营绩效（β=0.49）和韧性（β=0.46）强相关；（4）信度估计介于0.78-0.82之间，模型表现出可识别性和预期符号恢复。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了一个综合性的GSCM采纳模型，将六个理论上重要的前因变量整合在同一框架中；证明了模型的可识别性和预期符号恢复能力，为后续理论实证检验提供了方法学验证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为埃及制造业（及相似新兴经济体情境）的GSCM实践提供了模型框架参考，帮助识别影响绿色供应链采纳的关键杠杆点（外部压力、组织准备、人力能力、数字就绪、供应商协作和物流生态）；同时强调当前结果为仿真验证而非实证证据，提醒实践者在应用时需要后续真实数据验证。

title: Cyclical Fiscal Multipliers: Policy Mix and Financial Friction Puzzle
affiliations: and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Cyclical Fiscal Multipliers: Policy Mix and Financial Friction Puzzle
detail.abstract: We show that the widely accepted view that fiscal multipliers are larger during recessions is not a structural feature of the economy, but a consequence of the prevailing fiscal–monetary policy regime. Using a Time-Varying Parameter Vector Autoregression (TVP-VAR) estimated on U.S. data, we find that the relationship between fiscal multipliers and business cycles changed fundamentally after the 1980s. Before the Volcker disinflation, government spending multipliers increased during recessions, whereas under the subsequent monetary-led policy regime they became substantially smaller and, in some episodes, declined during downturns. These results indicate that fiscal multiplier dynamics are driven primarily by changes in the fiscal–monetary policy mix rather than by recessions themselves. We further document a new empirical puzzle: financial frictions, which historically amplified fiscal multipliers, appear to dampen them in the post-2000 period, particularly during the Global Financial Crisis. The findings imply that recession-based fiscal policy rules of thumb can be systematically misleading unless conditioned on the prevailing policy regime.​

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国数据的时变参数向量自回归（TVP-VAR）模型，发现财政乘数在经济衰退期间是否更大并非经济的结构性特征，而是取决于当时的财政-货币政策体制。1980年代（沃尔克反通胀）之前，衰退期间政府支出乘数会增加；而在随后的货币主导政策体制下，乘数变小甚至在某些时期衰退中下降。此外，文章发现一个实证谜团：金融摩擦在历史上放大财政乘数，但在2000年后（尤其全球金融危机期间）反而抑制乘数。
AI.research_question: 财政乘数在经济衰退期间是否系统性更大？这种关系是经济的内在结构性特征，还是由财政-货币政策体制所决定的？
AI.motivation: "衰退期间财政乘数更大"是宏观经济学中被广泛接受的观点，常被用作反周期财政政策的经验依据。作者希望检验这一"经验法则"是否具有普遍适用性，以及其背后的根本驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政-货币政策体制（fiscal-monetary policy regime）理论，财政主导与货币主导政策体制的区分；时变参数向量自回归（TVP-VAR）方法。
AI.method: 使用美国时间序列数据，估计时变参数向量自回归（TVP-VAR）模型，研究财政乘数与商业周期之间的关系随时间的变化，并以1980年代沃尔克反通胀作为政策体制转变的分界点进行分析。
AI.findings: 1）财政乘数与衰退的关系并非结构性特征，而是随财政-货币政策体制变化；2）沃尔克反通胀之前，衰退期间政府支出乘数增大；3）货币主导体制下，乘数显著变小，部分时期衰退中乘数反而下降；4）发现新谜团：金融摩擦历史上放大财政乘数，但2000年后尤其全球金融危机期间反而抑制乘数。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"衰退期间财政乘数更大"的广泛共识，提出财政乘数动态主要由财政-货币政策搭配驱动而非衰退本身，为财政政策效果研究提供了政策体制依赖的新理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出基于衰退的财政政策经验法则可能系统性误导政策制定，除非考虑当时的政策体制；为政策制定者在不同体制下制定财政刺激政策提供重要参考。

title: Searching for the Right Ingredients: A Recipe for Matching U.S. Labor Market Volatility
affiliations: Amherst College and Amherst College

detail.title: Searching for the Right Ingredients: A Recipe for Matching U.S. Labor Market Volatility
detail.abstract: Both job finding and job separation rates contribute substantially to unemployment rate volatility in the U.S., yet standard search and matching models of the labor market have difficulty matching both. Exogenous-separation models miss the volatility of inflows into unemployment entirely, while those with endogenous separations tend to understate the importance of the job finding rate. We present a framework with three ingredients that are sufficient to match both margins. Matches form with heterogeneous quality; initial productivity is near the bottom of the distribution, generating a tight fundamental surplus; and subsequent shocks to match quality can either lower or raise productivity. The model is able to match the volatilities of unemployment, labor market tightness, finding and separation rates, the autocorrelation of separations, the Beveridge curve, and the decomposition of unemployment fluctuations into contributions from each flow margin---all without resorting to wage rigidity or on-the-job search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个包含三个关键要素的搜索匹配模型——异质性匹配质量、初始生产率接近分布底端（产生紧凑的基本剩余）、以及匹配质量的后续正负双向冲击——该模型能够同时匹配美国劳动力市场中失业流入（离职率）和流出（就业寻找率）两个维度的波动性，并在无需工资刚性和在职搜索假设的情况下，匹配失业率、市场紧度、就业寻找率、离职率、贝弗里奇曲线及失业波动的流分解等一系列关键劳动力市场事实。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个搜索匹配模型，使其能够同时匹配美国劳动力市场中失业流入（job separation）与流出（job finding）两个边际对失业率波动的贡献？
AI.motivation: 标准的搜索匹配模型难以同时匹配美国劳动力市场的失业流入与流出波动：外生离职模型完全无法解释流入失业的波动性，而内生离职模型则往往低估就业寻找率的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 搜索与匹配模型（search and matching model），包含内生离职决策与异质性匹配质量。
AI.method: 构建包含三个关键要素的理论模型：1）匹配形成时具有异质性质量；2）初始生产率接近生产率分布的底端，产生"紧凑的基本剩余"（tight fundamental surplus）；3）匹配质量后续受到可升可降的生产率冲击。通过数值模拟与加州理工学院（US）宏观劳动力市场数据进行比较，检验模型的矩匹配表现。
AI.findings: 模型能够成功匹配失业率、劳动力市场紧度、就业寻找率、离职率各自的波动性，离职率的自相关性、贝弗里奇曲线，以及失业波动在各流动边际上的分解——且这些结果无需借助工资刚性或在职搜索等额外假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 为内生离职搜索匹配模型提供了一种新的建模机制组合（异质性匹配质量+低初始生产率+双向质量冲击），证明该机制足以同时解释失业流入与流出两个边际的波动，弥合了标准模型在这两个维度上的拟合困境。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了失业流入（离职）与流出（就业寻找）边际在解释美国失业波动中的相对重要性，为劳动力市场政策的制定（如失业保险设计、就业创造与就业保留政策）提供了理论基础。

title: Searching for the Right Ingredients: A Recipe for Matching U.S. Labor Market Volatility
affiliations: Amherst College and Amherst College

detail.title: Searching for the Right Ingredients: A Recipe for Matching U.S. Labor Market Volatility
detail.abstract: Both job finding and job separation rates contribute substantially to unemployment rate volatility in the U.S., yet standard search and matching models of the labor market have difficulty matching both. Exogenous-separation models miss the volatility of inflows into unemployment entirely, while those with endogenous separations tend to understate the importance of the job finding rate. We present a framework with three ingredients that are sufficient to match both margins. Matches form with heterogeneous quality; initial productivity is near the bottom of the distribution, generating a tight fundamental surplus; and subsequent shocks to match quality can either lower or raise productivity. The model is able to match the volatilities of unemployment, labor market tightness, finding and separation rates, the autocorrelation of separations, the Beveridge curve, and the decomposition of unemployment fluctuations into contributions from each flow margin---all without resorting to wage rigidity or on-the-job search.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含异质性匹配质量、低初始生产率和双向生产率冲击三个要素的劳动力市场搜索匹配模型，成功同时匹配了美国求职率和离职率对失业率波动的贡献，且无需依赖工资刚性和在职搜索假设。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够同时匹配美国劳动力市场中求职率（流入）和离职率（流出）对失业率波动贡献的标准搜索匹配模型？
AI.motivation: 标准搜索匹配模型难以同时匹配美国失业率波动的两个关键来源：求职率和离职率。外生离职模型完全无法解释失业流入的波动性，而内生离职模型又往往低估求职率的重要性。现有模型无法同时解释这两个边际。
AI.theoretical_framework: DMP搜索匹配模型框架，结合异质性匹配质量、内生内生分离决策和生产率冲击。
AI.method: 理论建模与数值模拟。构建包含三个关键要素的搜索匹配模型：1) 匹配形成时具有异质性质量；2) 初始生产率位于分布底部附近，产生紧致的基础剩余；3) 后续匹配质量冲击可上可下。通过校准模型匹配美国劳动力市场数据。
AI.findings: 模型成功匹配了以下关键事实：失业率波动性、劳动力市场紧度、求职率和离职率、离职率的自相关性、贝弗里奇曲线，以及失业率波动在两个流量边际上的分解——且无需依赖工资刚性或在职搜索假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的充分条件组合（异质性匹配质量+低初始生产率+双向质量冲击），使标准搜索匹配模型无需额外假设（如工资刚性、在职搜索）即可同时匹配失业流入和流出两个边际的波动性，弥补了该领域长期存在的理论缺口。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国劳动力市场的失业动态提供了更准确的模型工具，有助于政策制定者更好地理解失业率波动的来源构成（流入而非仅流出），从而设计更有效的劳动力市场政策。

title: Automation, Income Incidence, and Capital Accumulation in Incomplete Markets
affiliations: University of Michigan at Ann Arbor - Department of Mathematics

detail.title: Automation, Income Incidence, and Capital Accumulation in Incomplete Markets
detail.abstract: This paper studies how automation changes the stationary distribution of income, consumption, and wealth in an incomplete-market economy. An automating sector trades off productivity gains and labor-cost savings against adoption costs. Households differ by skill and wealth, save in a capital/equity claim, and face uninsurable skill risk. Competitive factor prices and aggregate capital clear jointly with household Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman equations and the stationary Kolmogorov forward equation. Automation affects consumption through labor-income incidence, precautionary saving, skill mobility, ownership of automation rents, and the stationary capital stock. In an adverseincidence scenario with high exposure, adverse reskilling, capital obsolescence, and concentrated ownership, decentralized automation lowers stationary consumption and capital relative to the no-automation allocation. With stronger productivity and complementarity, lower obsolescence, and broader ownership, automation raises output, consumption, and capital. Reversing the assumed skillmobility response also raises consumption, output, and capital substantially at a fixed automation intensity. A proxy diagnostic combining U.S. evidence on AI adoption, investment, labor-income pass-through, equity ownership, and marginal propensities to consume places the current economy near the boundary between the two scenarios. The model provides a quantitative framework for separating automation’s aggregate gains from its distributional incidence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在不完全市场经济中，自动化如何改变收入、消费和财富的稳态分布。自动化部门在生产力收益和劳动力成本节省与采用成本之间进行权衡。家庭在技能和财富上存在异质性，通过资本/股权进行储蓄，并面临不可保险的技能风险。自动化通过劳动收入影响、预防性储蓄、技能流动性、自动化租金所有权和稳态资本存量影响消费。在不利情形下（高暴露、不利再技能、资本过时和集中所有权），分散化自动化会降低稳态消费和资本；而在更强的生产力和互补性、更低过时性以及更广泛所有权下，自动化会提高产出、消费和资本。结合美国AI采用、投资、劳动收入传递、股权所有权和边际消费倾向的证据，当前经济处于两种情景的边界附近。
AI.research_question: 自动化如何在异质性不完全市场中改变收入、消费和财富的稳态分配？
AI.motivation: 自动化和AI的快速普及对宏观分配产生深远影响，但现有研究缺乏一个统一的量化框架来分离自动化的总体收益与分配性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全市场宏观经济模型；异质性家庭模型；Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman方程；Kolmogorov前向方程；自动化部门模型。
AI.method: 构建包含自动化部门的异质性不完全市场稳态均衡模型，通过竞争性要素价格、家庭HJB方程与Kolmogorov前向方程联合求解稳态分布，并结合美国数据校准诊断指标。
AI.findings: 自动化对稳态消费和资本的影响取决于两个情景：不利情景（高暴露、不利再技能、资本过时、集中所有权）下自动化降低稳态消费和资本；有利情景（更强生产力与互补性、更低过时性、更广泛所有权）下自动化提高产出、消费和资本。技能流动性假设的逆转也会大幅提高消费、产出和资本。基于美国证据的诊断显示当前经济接近两情景边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个统一的量化框架，将自动化的总体收益与分配性影响分离开来，识别了决定自动化福利效应方向的关键机制和参数。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估自动化对不同技能和财富群体分配影响的提供量化工具，有助于设计针对性政策（如再培训、股权分散化、降低资本过时性）以改善自动化结果。

title: Variable-Aware Regional Adaptation for Physics-Informed Neural Networks: A Guarded Control Framework
affiliations: Vellore Institute of Technology, Vellore and Jadavpur University

detail.title: Variable-Aware Regional Adaptation for Physics-Informed Neural Networks: A Guarded Control Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants, patients, animals, or identifiable personal data and therefore did not require ethics approval or informed consent.
declarations.funderStatement: Arawal Shukla received fellowship support through the Summer Research Fellowship Programme jointly sponsored by the Indian Academy of Sciences, the Indian National Science Academy, and The National Academy of Sciences, India. The sponsors had no role in the study design; data collection, analysis, or interpretation; preparation of the manuscript; or decision to submit the work for publication.

detail.abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) can fit an aggregate partial differential equation (PDE) objective while retaining errors concentrated in one physical variable, residual channel, or part of the domain. We introduce Variable-Aware Regional Adaptation for physics-informed neural networks (VARA-PINN), a channel-region adaptation framework whose guarded controller instantiations diagnose this structure and reallocate a fixed PINN training budget. A channel-by-region severity tensor proposes changes to collocation density and local loss weight; guarded variants screen proposals for gradient conflict, test them against matched neutral probes, and restore state when reference-free guard metrics deteriorate beyond tolerance. Tests combine guarded analytical and transient studies with sparse-data lid-driven cavity reconstruction and Reynolds-number continuation using the same channel-region allocation principle. Across five seeds, VARA reduces Kovasznay errors by 33–46%, while the sparse-CFD cavity instantiation reduces full-field velocity error by 9.1% and sparse-velocity mean-square error by 26.2%. It wins 29/35 paired Allen–Cahn comparisons and 21/21 advection–diffusion comparisons, with mean normalized reductions of 35.1% and 58.6%, respectively. Five-seed mechanism and sensitivity studies identify regional allocation as the principal scalar-PDE mechanism and show stability under moderate controller perturbations. A complementary single-seed sweep improves the reference-free cavity aggregate at 14 of 15 Reynolds numbers from 100 to 10,000. Under these protocols, VARA-PINN improves field reconstruction and localized error correction without requiring dense reference access during training; it does not imply that every residual channel improves in every run.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VARA-PINN（Variable-Aware Regional Adaptation for physics-informed neural networks），一种通道-区域自适应框架，通过守护控制器诊断PINN训练中误差在物理变量、残差通道或区域中的分布结构，并重新分配固定训练预算（配点密度和局部损失权重），以改善场重建和局部误差校正，无需密集参考数据。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种自适应机制，使得PINN在拟合聚合偏微分方程目标时，能够识别并纠正误差集中在特定物理变量、残差通道或域内区域的非均匀分布问题？
AI.motivation: 传统PINN在拟合聚合PDE目标时，误差往往集中在某个物理变量、残留通道或区域中，导致整体预测精度不均衡；而固定训练预算下缺乏有效的自适应分配策略来诊断和重分配资源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）、通道-区域误差严重度张量、守护控制理论（梯度冲突检测、中性探针测试、参考无关守护度量）、自适应配点密度与损失权重分配
AI.method: 提出VARA-PINN框架：(1)构建通道×区域严重度张量以识别误差分布结构；(2)提出配点密度和局部损失权重的再分配方案；(3)引入守护控制器变体，筛查梯度冲突、用匹配中性探针测试提议、在守护度量恶化超容忍度时恢复状态；(4)通过解析测试（Kovasznay）、稀疏数据腔流重建、雷诺数延续、Allen-Cahn和advection-diffusion方程等多组实验验证。
AI.findings: (1) Kovasznay误差降低33-46%；(2) 稀疏CFD腔流实例中全场速度误差降低9.1%，稀疏速度均方误差降低26.2%；(3) 在35组Allen-Cahn对比中获胜29组，21/21获胜advection-diffusion对比，平均归一化减少分别达35.1%和58.6%；(4) 机制分析表明区域分配是标量PDE的主要机制；(5) 在14/15个雷诺数（100-10000）下改善无参考腔流聚合指标；系统在中等控制器扰动下保持稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出通道-区域自适应分配理论框架，将误差严重度张量作为诊断工具，引入守护控制机制保障训练稳定性，并从机制层面识别区域分配作为标量PDE误差校正的主导机制，深化了对PINN误差分布结构及其调控策略的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种无需密集参考数据即可改善PINN场重建和局部误差校正的计算框架；在雷诺数延续（100-10000）和稀疏数据场景下表现稳健，适用于实际工程中数据稀缺但需要高精度局部预测的PDE求解场景。

title: Automation, Income Incidence, and Capital Accumulation in Incomplete Markets
affiliations: University of Michigan at Ann Arbor - Department of Mathematics

detail.title: Automation, Income Incidence, and Capital Accumulation in Incomplete Markets
detail.abstract: This paper studies how automation changes the stationary distribution of income, consumption, and wealth in an incomplete-market economy. An automating sector trades off productivity gains and labor-cost savings against adoption costs. Households differ by skill and wealth, save in a capital/equity claim, and face uninsurable skill risk. Competitive factor prices and aggregate capital clear jointly with household Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman equations and the stationary Kolmogorov forward equation. Automation affects consumption through labor-income incidence, precautionary saving, skill mobility, ownership of automation rents, and the stationary capital stock. In an adverseincidence scenario with high exposure, adverse reskilling, capital obsolescence, and concentrated ownership, decentralized automation lowers stationary consumption and capital relative to the no-automation allocation. With stronger productivity and complementarity, lower obsolescence, and broader ownership, automation raises output, consumption, and capital. Reversing the assumed skillmobility response also raises consumption, output, and capital substantially at a fixed automation intensity. A proxy diagnostic combining U.S. evidence on AI adoption, investment, labor-income pass-through, equity ownership, and marginal propensities to consume places the current economy near the boundary between the two scenarios. The model provides a quantitative framework for separating automation’s aggregate gains from its distributional incidence.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个不完全市场的一般均衡模型，研究自动化如何改变收入、消费和财富的稳态分布。模型将自动化部门的生产率收益与劳动成本节约同采用成本进行权衡，家庭在技能和财富上存在异质性，面临不可保险的技能风险。研究发现，自动化对消费的影响取决于劳动收入冲击、预防性储蓄、技能流动性、自动化租金所有权和稳态资本存量等多重渠道。在不利情形（高暴露、不利再技能、资本过时、租金集中）下，自动化降低稳态消费和资本；而在有利条件下则提升产出、消费和资本。基于美国AI采用证据的诊断显示当前经济处于两种情景的边界附近。
AI.research_question: 自动化如何改变不完全市场经济中收入、消费和财富的稳态分布？
AI.motivation: 自动化（特别是AI）对宏观经济分配的影响是当前重大议题，但缺乏一个能够同时捕捉自动化收益与分配后果的定量框架。现有文献多关注局部均衡或代表性主体，未能充分刻画自动化通过多种渠道（劳动收入、预防性储蓄、技能流动、资本所有权、总资本存量）影响消费与福利的完整机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全市场一般均衡模型（Bewley-Huggett-Aiyagari类模型），结合Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程与Kolmogorov forward方程求解稳态分布；自动化部门内生技术采用决策；异质性家庭面临不可保险的技能风险。
AI.method: 理论建模与数值求解。构建包含自动化部门的不完全市场异质性主体模型，竞争性要素价格与总资本联合出清，求解稳态均衡。基于美国AI采用、投资、劳动收入传导、股权所有权和边际消费倾向等实证证据构建代理诊断指标，评估经济所处情景。
AI.findings: （1）在不利情景下（高暴露、不利再技能、资本过时、租金集中），自动化降低稳态消费和资本；（2）在有利条件下（强生产率与互补性、低过时、广泛所有权），自动化提升产出、消费和资本；（3）翻转技能流动性假设会显著提高消费、产出和资本；（4）基于美国证据的诊断显示当前经济处于两种情景的边界附近。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次在异质性不完全市场框架中系统刻画自动化的多重分配渠道及其互动机制；（2）将自动化收益（生产率）与分配后果（劳动收入冲击、租金所有权）统一在一个可量化的一般均衡框架中；（3）为区分自动化的总体收益与分配影响提供了新的理论分离方法。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供了评估自动化（尤其AI）宏观影响的定量框架，可指导政策制定；（2）"代理诊断"方法将美国实证证据与理论模型对接，为判断经济所处情景提供可操作工具；（3）识别了影响自动化福利后果的关键参数（技能流动性、资本过时、所有权分布），为政策干预方向提供依据。

title: Cyclical Fiscal Multipliers: Policy Mix and Financial Friction Puzzle
affiliations: and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Cyclical Fiscal Multipliers: Policy Mix and Financial Friction Puzzle
detail.abstract: We show that the widely accepted view that fiscal multipliers are larger during recessions is not a structural feature of the economy, but a consequence of the prevailing fiscal–monetary policy regime. Using a Time-Varying Parameter Vector Autoregression (TVP-VAR) estimated on U.S. data, we find that the relationship between fiscal multipliers and business cycles changed fundamentally after the 1980s. Before the Volcker disinflation, government spending multipliers increased during recessions, whereas under the subsequent monetary-led policy regime they became substantially smaller and, in some episodes, declined during downturns. These results indicate that fiscal multiplier dynamics are driven primarily by changes in the fiscal–monetary policy mix rather than by recessions themselves. We further document a new empirical puzzle: financial frictions, which historically amplified fiscal multipliers, appear to dampen them in the post-2000 period, particularly during the Global Financial Crisis. The findings imply that recession-based fiscal policy rules of thumb can be systematically misleading unless conditioned on the prevailing policy regime.​

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国数据的时变参数向量自回归模型（TVP-VAR），证明财政乘数在经济衰退期间变大的观点并非经济体的结构性特征，而是由当时盛行的财政-货币政策制度决定的。1980年代（沃尔克反通胀）前后，财政乘数与商业周期的关系发生了根本性变化：此前的衰退期间政府支出乘数增大，而此后在货币主导的政策制度下乘数显著变小，某些时期甚至在经济下行期下降。研究还发现了新的经验谜题：历史上放大财政乘数的金融摩擦，在2000年后反而抑制乘数，尤其是全球金融危机期间。结论表明，基于衰退的财政政策经验法则若不考虑当时政策制度，可能具有系统性误导性。
AI.research_question: 财政乘数在经济衰退期间是否系统性更大？这种关系是经济体的结构性特征，还是由财政-货币政策制度所决定？
AI.motivation: 流行的观点认为衰退期间财政乘数更大，但现有研究忽视了财政-货币政策制度对乘数动态的决定性作用。作者旨在打破这一被广泛接受但可能具有误导性的认知，揭示财政乘数与商业周期关系的制度依赖性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政乘数理论、财政-货币政策制度框架（财政主导vs货币主导）、时变参数方法（TVP-VAR）
AI.method: 使用美国数据估计时变参数向量自回归模型（TVP-VAR），分析财政乘数随时间变化及其与商业周期的关系，并比较1980年代（沃尔克反通胀）前后的不同政策制度区间。
AI.findings: 1) 财政乘数与商业周期的关系在1980年代后发生根本性变化：沃尔克反通胀之前，衰退期间政府支出乘数增大；此后在货币主导政策下乘数显著变小，某些时期在衰退中下降。2) 财政乘数动态主要由财政-货币政策组合变化驱动，而非衰退本身。3) 发现新经验谜题：历史上放大乘数的金融摩擦，在2000年后反而抑制乘数，尤其在2008年全球金融危机期间。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 挑战并修正了"衰退期间财政乘数更大"这一被广泛接受的观点，指出其本质是政策制度依赖而非结构性事实。2) 将财政乘数研究与财政-货币政策制度框架联系起来，为理解乘数动态提供了新的理论视角。3) 首次系统揭示金融摩擦对财政乘数影响的制度依赖性，提出新的经验谜题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供重要警示：基于衰退的财政政策经验法则（如衰退期间加大财政刺激）可能因忽视当时的政策制度而具有系统性误导性。2) 帮助政策制定者根据当前财政-货币政策制度来评估财政刺激政策的实际效果，制定更为精准的财政政策。

title: The Six Syndromes of Pakistan's Political Economy: A Mathematical Theory of Socialized Costs, Institutional Learning, and Macroeconomic Fragility
affiliations: Independent and Quaid-i-Azam University

detail.title: The Six Syndromes of Pakistan's Political Economy: A Mathematical Theory of Socialized Costs, Institutional Learning, and Macroeconomic Fragility
detail.abstract: Pakistan's recurrent episodes of fiscal stress, expensive credit, power-sector arrears, stateowned-enterprise losses, regulatory fragmentation, subsidy dependence, and commodity-market interventions are generally examined as separate policy failures. This paper develops a unified political-economy framework in which these phenomena are interpreted as six mutually reinforcing economic syndromes: the Interest Rate Syndrome, Independent Power Producers (IPPs) Syndrome, State-Owned Enterprises (SOEs) Syndrome, Governance Syndrome, Subsidiaries Syndrome and the Commodities Inverted Import and Export Syndrome. The central mechanism is a cost-socialization trap: concentrated groups can retain identifiable benefits while significant portions of the associated fiscal, quasi-fiscal, regulatory, financing, or price costs are transmitted to diffuse households, taxpayers, firms, bank borrowers, and future public budgets. The paper develops a micro-founded political-economy model of distortion persistence, a fiscal-banking model of interest-rate amplification and sovereign crowding out, a capacity-transmission model of electricity tariffs, a softbudget-constraint model of SOEs, a multi-agency rent-extraction model of governance, a distributional model of subsidy capture, and a DeGroot social-learning model of information aggregation and policy error. The framework yields ten analytical propositions. Among them, monetary tightening is shown to have larger real effects when sovereign refinancing exposure and banking-sector government exposure are high; generation expansion can raise electricity tariffs without increasing deliverable electricity when transmission constraints bind; fragmented regulatory extraction produces a larger aggregate burden than coordinated extraction; soft budget constraints reduce managerial effort; untargeted quantity subsidies reproduce underlying asset concentration; and influential biased signals in policy networks increase the probability of erroneous commodity export decisions followed by costly import reversals. Pakistan provides an institutionally revealing setting for these mechanisms. Official FY2025-26 data report markup payments equivalent to 5.5 percent of GDP; scheduled-bank budgetary lending to government of Rs2.79 trillion during July-March compared with Rs934.1 billion of private-sector credit; installed electricity capacity of 49,651 MW amid continuing capacity, network, and circular-debt reforms; and substantial fiscal exposure to SOEs. These facts do not, by themselves, establish causality, but they motivate a falsifiable empirical agenda using monetary shocks, firm and bank exposure, plant-grid data, SOE reforms, administrative digitalization, household microdata, and commodity-level policy events. The paper's contribution is therefore to show analytically how sector-specific distortions can become endogenously interconnected through fiscal socialization, institutional networks, trust, and privatesector incentives, generating a persistent low-investment and low-productivity equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的政治经济学框架，将巴基斯坦反复出现的财政压力、高利率、电力部门欠款、国有企业亏损、监管碎片化、补贴依赖和商品市场干预等八类现象解释为六个相互强化的经济综合征（利率、独立电力生产商、国有企业、治理、子公司和商品进出口倒挂）。核心机制是"成本社会化陷阱"——集中群体保留可识别的利益，而相关成本则转嫁给分散的家庭、纳税人、企业和未来公共预算。文章构建了多个微观基础模型并推导出十项分析命题，最终论证部门特定扭曲如何通过财政社会化、制度网络、信任和私人部门激励内生地相互关联，形成持续的低投资、低生产率均衡。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦的财政压力、高额信贷成本、电力部门欠款、国有企业亏损、监管碎片化、补贴依赖和商品市场干预为何会同时持续存在并相互强化？这些看似独立的政策失败是否共享共同的政治经济学根源？
AI.motivation: 既有研究通常将这些政策失败分开分析，缺乏统一的解释框架。作者试图表明这些现象并非孤立问题，而是通过成本社会化机制内生地相互关联，共同构成一个自我维持的低效率均衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本社会化陷阱理论；扭曲持续性的微观基础政治经济学模型；财政-银行模型（利率放大与主权挤出）；电力容量-输电模型；国有企业软预算约束模型；多机构寻租的治理模型；补贴捕获的分配模型；DeGroot社会学习模型（信息聚合与政策错误）
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建多个微观基础模型（财政-银行、容量-传输、软预算约束、多代理寻租、分配博弈、社会学习），推导十项分析命题；辅以巴基斯坦官方FY2025-26数据作为制度背景的经验启示，并提出基于货币冲击、企业与银行暴露、工厂-电网数据和政策事件的实证研究议程。
AI.findings: 十项命题包括：当主权再融资暴露和银行政府敞口高时，货币紧缩具有更大的实际效应；输电约束下，发电扩张可提高电价但不增加可交付电力；碎片化监管提取的总负担大于协调提取；软预算约束降低管理努力；未定向的数量补贴复制了底层资产集中；政策网络中有影响力的有偏信号增加错误商品出口决策及后续昂贵进口逆转的概率。巴基斯坦数据揭示：利息支付占GDP的5.5%，政府银行借贷远超私人信贷，装机容量49,651 MW但伴随容量与循环债务问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个统一的分析框架来理解看似独立的部门扭曲如何在政治经济层面内生互联；将成本社会化概念形式化为多模型的理论体系；阐明了财政社会化、制度网络、信任和私人部门激励如何共同生成低投资、低生产率的持续均衡，而非孤立的政策失败。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦及面临类似制度约束的发展中国家提供了诊断性框架，有助于识别政策改革的杠杆点（如输电瓶颈、监管协调、补贴设计、政策网络信息偏差矫正），并提出了可证伪的实证研究议程，指导未来基于微观数据和政策事件的经验研究。

title: Monetary Policy Transmission by Securitising Banks
affiliations: Banque de France and

detail.title: Monetary Policy Transmission by Securitising Banks
detail.abstract: This paper studies whether securitisation affects monetary policy transmission via banks. Using granular loan-level data from the euro area, we show that banks actively engaged in securitisation adjust credit supply more strongly in response to monetary policy shocks than a matched sample of non-securitising banks. This is because securitisation expands banks' lending capacity, but by increasing reliance on investors whose required returns and risk appetite are more sensitive to monetary policy conditions. Following a monetary tightening, these investors demand higher compensation and reduce their exposure to securitised assets, leading securitising banks to contract lending more than other banks. Effects are stronger for loans more likely to be securitised-i.e., to safer borrowers with longer maturities-and are primarily driven by synthetic securitisations, which provide additional capital relief through Significant Risk Transfers. Firms exposed to securitising banks cannot fully substitute tighter loan supply through existing or new bank relationships.

AI.tldr: 本文利用欧元区银行层面的贷款数据，研究证券化如何影响货币政策通过银行渠道的传导。研究发现，积极参与证券化的银行对货币政策冲击的信贷供给调整幅度大于匹配的非证券化银行，这主要是因为证券化扩大了银行的放贷能力，但也增加了对投资者（其要求回报和风险偏好对货币政策更敏感）的依赖。货币紧缩时这些投资者要求更高补偿并减少证券化资产敞口，导致证券化银行收缩信贷更多。效应在更可能被证券化的贷款（更安全、期限更长的借款人）中更强，且主要由提供重大风险转移（SRT）资本减免的合成证券化驱动。暴露于证券化银行的企业无法通过现有或新的银行关系完全替代紧缩的贷款供给。
AI.research_question: 证券化是否以及如何影响货币政策通过银行渠道的传导？
AI.motivation: 尽管证券化在金融危机后受到广泛关注，但现有文献对证券化如何影响货币政策传导机制的研究尚不充分，尤其是缺乏使用微观层面贷款数据对两者关系的实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行信贷渠道理论、证券化与银行放贷能力扩张理论、投资者风险偏好与货币政策传导机制
AI.method: 使用欧元区银行层面的贷款数据，采用匹配样本（证券化银行 vs 非证券化银行）的实证方法，研究货币政策冲击对不同类型银行信贷供给的差异化影响。
AI.findings: （1）证券化银行对货币政策冲击的信贷供给调整显著强于非证券化银行；（2）该效应源于证券化银行对市场投资者的更高依赖；（3）效应在更可能被证券化的贷款（更安全、期限更长）中更强；（4）主要由合成证券化（通过重大风险转移获得资本减免）驱动；（5）企业借款人无法通过其他银行关系完全替代证券化银行的贷款供给缩减。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文拓展了货币政策银行传导渠道的理论框架，揭示了证券化作为中介因素如何放大货币政策冲击对银行信贷供给的影响，深化了对证券化影响银行体系结构与货币政策有效性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结论对监管机构评估证券化监管政策（尤其是合成证券化与重大风险转移）的宏观经济影响具有参考价值，同时也提醒政策制定者关注货币政策传导中证券化银行行为可能带来的放大效应。

title: A Regulator's Career Option: Revolving Doors, Regulatory Signals, and Firm Tail Risk
affiliations: University of Leicester

detail.title: A Regulator's Career Option: Revolving Doors, Regulatory Signals, and Firm Tail Risk

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This paper develops a model of revolving doors in which a regulator designs policy signals that affect a regulated firm’s capital structure while holding an implicit career option to leave public service and join the regulated firm or its advisers. The model has three linked mechanisms. First, regulatory signals alter the firm’s admissible pricing and leverage choices by changing the tradeoff between consumer surplus and firm profit. Second, because the regulator’s outside payoff is convex in the value of the regulated firm, the value of the regulator’s career option increases with firm value, leverage, and signal-induced volatility. Third, when signal-induced volatility raises the option vega of firm equity, the same mechanism can increase tail risk and lower distance to default. A proof-of-concept calibration illustrates the model’s leverage-vega warning regions and shows how a regulator-induced signal can move a firm from a go-leverage region into an early-warning or crash-risk region. The calibration is extended with maturity comparisons, a sensitivity grid overcompensation convexity and initial leverage, a bank-like parameter anchor, stochastic signal simulations, and a stopping-horizon diagnostic. External evidence from federal payroll data on post-employment restrictions supports the model’s career option primitive, while the exercises also organize historical regulatory failures: Lehman Brothers as a regulatory-vacuum case, Silicon Valley Bank as a distorted-signal and weak-supervision case, and Signature Bank as a converted-signal case in which post-public-service incentives and lighter oversight coincided with rapid growth, uninsured-deposit exposure, and tail risk. The model does not predict collapse dates; it helps explain and predict when regulatory forbearance, weak debt penalties, and career-option incentives can delay binding oversight until firms cross a leverage-vega warning threshold.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个"旋转门"模型，研究监管者在持有加入受监管企业或其顾问的职业期权时，如何设计影响企业资本结构的监管信号。模型包含三个联动机制：监管信号改变企业定价与杠杆选择；监管者外部报酬的凸性使其职业期权价值随企业价值、杠杆和信号引致的波动率上升；信号引致的波动率提高股权期权vega，可能增加尾部风险并降低违约距离。校准实验展示了杠杆-vega预警区域，并通过历史案例（雷曼、硅谷银行、签名银行）验证了模型解释力。
AI.research_question: 监管者的旋转门职业期权如何影响其监管信号设计，进而影响受监管企业的资本结构、杠杆选择与系统性风险？
AI.motivation: 现有文献未充分建模监管者职业生涯动机（旋转门）与监管信号设计之间的相互作用，以及这种互动如何通过杠杆-vega机制影响企业尾部风险和违约概率。历史上的监管失败案例（如雷曼兄弟、硅谷银行、签名银行）表明需要更系统化的理论框架来解释监管宽容何时出现以及何时失效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 旋转门理论（revolving door theory）；监管信号设计理论；资本结构理论（定价-杠杆权衡）；期权定价理论（vega与尾部风险）；职业期权理论（career option）
AI.method: 理论建模（三机制联动模型）；校准实验（proof-of-concept calibration）；参数敏感性分析；历史案例比较分析；联邦工资单数据的实证验证
AI.findings: 信号引致的波动率会提高企业股权期权vega，增加尾部风险并降低违约距离；校准显示监管者信号可将企业从"可杠杆区域"推入"预警区域"或"崩溃风险区域"；模型成功组织了雷曼兄弟（监管真空）、硅谷银行（信号扭曲与弱监管）、签名银行（信号转换）等历史监管失败案例；但模型不预测崩溃日期，仅解释和预测监管宽容何时延迟约束监督直至企业越过杠杆-vega预警阈值。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将旋转门职业期权纳入监管信号设计的理论框架；建立了监管者职业动机-企业资本结构-系统性风险之间的三机制联动理论；提出了"杠杆-vega预警区域"的新概念，将期权定价理论中的vega概念整合到监管经济学分析中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构识别预警信号提供了可操作的工具（杠杆-vega预警区域）；通过历史案例验证为金融监管改革提供经验依据；后就业限制（post-employment restrictions）的实证证据支持了加强职业期权约束的政策方向；为区分不同类型的监管失败（真空型、扭曲型、转换型）提供了分类诊断框架。

title: Exchange Rate Movements and Consumer Price Inflation in Pakistan: A Monthly Descriptive and Correlation Analysis, 2020-2025

detail.title: Exchange Rate Movements and Consumer Price Inflation in Pakistan: A Monthly Descriptive and Correlation Analysis, 2020-2025

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest or personal or financial relationships that could have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval Ethics approval was not required for this research as it involved the use of publicly available secondary macroeconomic data and did not include human participants or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was not supported by any specific grant from any funding agency, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This study examines the relationship between exchange rate movements and consumer price inflation in Pakistan over the period January 2020 to June 2025. The analysis uses 66 monthly observations of the USD/PKR exchange rate obtained from the State Bank of Pakistan and CPI-based inflation data obtained from the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics. Descriptive statistics, monthly trend analysis, and Pearson's product-moment correlation coefficient are employed to examine the co-movement between exchange rates and consumer price inflation. The results indicate a moderate positive correlation between the USD/PKR exchange rate and inflation, with a Pearson correlation coefficient of r = 0.423 . The period from 2022 to 2023 is characterized by pronounced exchange-rate depreciation alongside elevated inflation, while both indicators show comparatively lower inflationary momentum during the subsequent period. The observed positive association is consistent with the theoretical view that exchange-rate depreciation can contribute to domestic price pressures through higher import costs and production expenses. However, the bivariate correlation does not establish a causal relationship, and other factors, including commodity prices, monetary conditions, energy costs, fiscal developments, and supply-side disruptions, may also have influenced inflation during the study period. The findings provide descriptive evidence on exchange-rate and inflation dynamics in Pakistan and provide a basis for future research using multivariate and time-series econometric methods.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2020年1月至2025年6月期间巴基斯坦卢比对美元汇率变动与消费者价格通胀之间的关系，基于66个月度观测数据，采用描述性统计、月度趋势分析及皮尔逊相关系数，发现两者存在中等程度的正相关（r=0.423），其中2022-2023年期间汇率贬值和通胀均显著上升，但作者指出双变量相关并不能确立因果关系。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦汇率变动与消费者价格通胀之间存在什么样的关系？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦近年来经历显著的本币贬值和通胀压力，需要实证考察汇率变动与通胀之间的联动关系，为政策制定提供参考依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 汇率传递理论（Exchange Rate Pass-through），即汇率贬值通过提高进口成本和国内生产成本推动国内价格水平上升。
AI.method: 使用来自巴基斯坦国家银行的USD/PKR汇率数据和巴基斯坦统计局CPI通胀数据（2020年1月至2025年6月共66个月度观测），采用描述性统计、月度趋势分析以及皮尔逊积矩相关系数分析。
AI.findings: USD/PKR汇率与通胀之间存在中等程度的正相关关系（r=0.423）；2022-2023年期间汇率大幅贬值和通胀高企并存；后续时期两者通胀动能均相对较低。但该相关不意味着因果关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 为汇率传递理论提供了巴基斯坦情境下的描述性实证证据，验证了汇率贬值通过进口成本和生产费用渠道推动国内价格压力的理论预期。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦政策制定者理解汇率与通胀动态关系提供了经验基础，指出需通过多变量和时间序列计量方法进一步探究，并为未来研究指明了方向。

title: Multipolar Currency System: Prerequisites, Risks and Mechanisms of Formation

detail.title: Multipolar Currency System: Prerequisites, Risks and Mechanisms of Formation
detail.abstract: The article examines the prerequisites for the formation of a multipolar monetary system as a more distributed model of the international monetary architecture, within which several centers of liquidity, settlements and reserves compete and coexist. It is shown that the modern transformation of the global monetary system is determined not only by the redistribution of the role of individual currencies, but also by the development of payment infrastructure, regional financial institutions, currency swaps and digital instruments. A typology of scenarios for the formation of a new monetary architecture is proposed, including soft multipolarity, regional multipolarity and a fragmented multi-contour system.

AI.tldr: 本文考察了多极货币体系形成的先决条件，这是一种更分散的国际货币架构模型，其中多个流动性、结算和储备中心竞争并存。研究指出全球货币体系的现代转型不仅由个别货币角色的再分配决定，还取决于支付基础设施、区域金融机构、货币互换和数字工具的发展。文章提出了新货币架构形成的场景类型学，包括软性多极、区域多极和碎片化多回路体系。
AI.research_question: 多极货币体系形成的先决条件是什么？国际货币架构如何向更分散的多中心模型转型？
AI.motivation: 全球货币体系正在经历深刻变革，单一主导货币（如美元）的地位受到挑战，需要系统性理解多极货币体系形成的条件和可能的路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多极货币体系理论、国际货币架构理论、货币区域化与全球化理论
AI.method: 理论分析与场景类型学构建，基于对支付基础设施、区域金融机构、货币互换和数字工具等要素的系统考察
AI.findings: 全球货币体系转型不仅涉及个别货币角色的再分配，还取决于支付基础设施、区域金融机构、货币互换及数字工具的发展；提出了三种多极货币架构形成的场景类型：软性多极性、区域多极性和碎片化多回路体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了多极货币体系形成的场景类型学框架，丰富了国际货币架构理论，超越了传统的单一货币霸权更替视角，将支付基础设施、数字工具等新兴要素纳入分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和国际金融机构理解全球货币体系转型方向提供分析工具，有助于各国在多元化货币体系形成过程中进行战略定位和风险管理。

title: Property in Information: A Formal Analysis of Forty-Five Works
affiliations: University of Exeter

detail.title: Property in Information: A Formal Analysis of Forty-Five Works
detail.abstract: This paper analyses forty-five works on property in information under a single method applied without variation to every author: premises are isolated in the author's own words and rendered in a formal notation, examined singly, then reassembled into the arguments they compose and tested for validity, with every fallacy named by its standard name and demonstrated by explicit derivation or counter-model rather than asserted. Part One treats the thirty works the case against intellectual property cites, contests or relies upon, among them.

AI.tldr: 本文对45部关于信息财产的作品采用统一方法进行分析：以作者原话提取前提，用形式化记号表示，逐一检验，再重组为论证并测试其有效性，每个谬误均以标准名称命名并通过明确推导或反例模型加以证明。第一部分处理反对知识产权案例所引用、质疑或依赖的30部作品。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地分析文献中关于信息财产论证的有效性，并识别其中的谬误？
AI.motivation: 现有关于知识产权和信息的文献争论中存在大量未经验证的论证，需要一个严格、统一的分析方法对所有相关作品进行逻辑检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 形式逻辑与谬误理论
AI.method: 对每部作品采用统一方法：提取前提（以作者原话并形式化表示）→ 单独检验前提 → 重组为完整论证 → 测试论证有效性 → 命名并演示每个谬误（通过显式推导或反例模型）
AI.findings: 在45部作品中发现各种逻辑谬误，每项谬误均以标准名称标识并通过推导或反例模型加以证明；第一部分涵盖的30部反对知识产权案例的作品中存在系统性的逻辑问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一种系统化的方法论，用于对法律/哲学文献论证进行严格的形式逻辑分析，并建立了识别学术论证中谬误的标准化程序。
AI.practical_contributions: 为知识产权和信息财产领域的学术争论提供了严谨的逻辑审查工具，帮助学者和政策制定者评估相关论证的可信度。

title: Terrorism and Trust: An International Perspective

detail.title: Terrorism and Trust: An International Perspective

keywords: Social Norms and Social Capital Provide your feedback on BizChat

detail.abstract: I study the effect of terrorist attacks on people’s trust in their families and diverse in–group and out–group social groups, exploiting the quasi–random overlap between the Global Terrorism Database and the World Values Survey at the regional level across 20 countries. I use a sharp regression discontinuity design as identification strategy. The coefficient of interest captures the effect on people’s trust level when exposed to a terrorist attack. This research contributes to three literatures, emphasizing its international perspective: i. It analyzes the differential impact of terrorism on trust across different social groups; ii. It contributes with a methodology that moves away from experimental designs to assess the effects of terrorism on people’s trust; and iii. It studies low–intensity terrorism at a regional level with a worldwide perspective, going beyond the major terrorist attacks. The main finding is that trust toward unknown people declines by 0.47–0.61 Likert–scale units (approximately 25–32% of the mean), an effect that is robust to data–driven bandwidth selection (Calonico, Cattaneo & Titiunik, 2014), leave–one–out country exclusions, and placebo cutoff tests. Evidence of effects on trust toward people of other nationalities is suggestive but sensitive to specification. No robust effects are found on trust toward people of other religions. Changes in trust toward known people are not statistically different from zero. Heterogeneous effects are explored by region, country, and individual characteristics, which reinforce the hypothesis that social reconstruction mechanisms operate with greater speed and effectiveness in contexts where prior social capital density is high.

AI.tldr: 本文利用全球恐怖主义数据库与世界价值观调查在区域层面的准随机重叠数据，采用断点回归设计，研究恐怖袭击对人们信任水平的影响。主要发现是恐怖袭击显著降低了人们对陌生人的信任（下降0.47-0.61 Likert单位，约25-32%），但对家人、熟人、其他宗教群体的信任无显著影响。异质性分析表明，社会资本密度高的地区，社会重建机制运作更快更有效。
AI.research_question: 恐怖袭击如何影响人们对家庭、内群体和外群体各类社会群体的信任水平？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于重大恐怖袭击的效应且依赖实验设计，缺乏对低强度恐怖主义在世界范围内、区域层面效应的系统考察，也缺乏对不同社会群体信任差异化影响的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会信任理论、社会资本理论、群体内/群体外偏差理论
AI.method: 利用全球恐怖主义数据库（GTD）与世界价值观调查（WVS）在20个国家区域层面的数据，采用断点回归设计（RDD）作为识别策略，通过Calonico等（2014）数据驱动带宽选择、留一国家排除和安慰剂断点检验进行稳健性分析。
AI.findings: （1）恐怖袭击显著降低对陌生人的信任（约25-32%），该效应稳健；（2）对其他国籍人群信任的效应仅是提示性的且对设定敏感；（3）对其他宗教人群信任无稳健效应；（4）对熟人的信任变化在统计上不显著；（5）异质性分析表明社会资本密度高的背景下，社会重建机制运作更快更有效。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出并分析恐怖主义对不同社会群体信任的差异化影响；（2）提供超越实验设计的计量方法论，评估恐怖主义对信任的因果效应；（3）以全球视角研究区域层面的低强度恐怖主义，超越重大恐怖袭击的局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解恐怖袭击对社会信任的破坏范围提供实证依据，表明恐怖袭击主要侵蚀对陌生人的信任而非熟人信任，且社会资本可作为社会韧性的缓冲机制，为反恐政策和社会重建策略提供参考。

title: Air Pollution and Labor Productivity: Evidence From a Global Panel

detail.title: Air Pollution and Labor Productivity: Evidence From a Global Panel
detail.abstract: I estimate the effect of ambient air pollution on labor productivity at the macroeconomic level, using an unbalanced panel of 94 countries over 2011-2021. The panel combines WHO pollutant data (PM2.5, PM10, NO₂) with ILO productivity series, Penn World Tables controls, and WHO health expenditure data. I anchor the estimating equation in a semi-endogenous growth model extending Jones (1995) with a pollutionimpairment channel that delivers three testable predictions: a negative balanced-growth-path semi-elasticity of output per worker with respect to steady-state pollution (Proposition 1), independence of the long-run growth rate from pollution concentration (Proposition 2), and full comparative statics that nest the augmented Solow model while adding an orthogonal pollution term (Proposition 3). The preferred firstdifference estimator yields β̂ =-0.00037 (p = 0.048), implying that a 10 μg/m³ increase in annual mean PM2.5 reduces GDP per worker by 0.37 percent, approximately $248 per worker per year at the sample mean of $67,900. The system-GMM estimator, which corrects for the attenuation bias induced by reverse causality between productivity and pollution abatement, shifts the estimate to β̂ =-0.00179 (p = 0.039). Dynamic fixed-effects specifications recover long-run BGP semi-elasticities of β_LR =-0.00042 to-0.00057 across lag structures of one, three, and five years, consistent with pollution operating as a permanent level drag. PM10 yields a consistent negative coefficient across first-difference specifications; NO₂ does not, reflecting within-country confounding between nitrogen dioxide and economic activity that the panel cannot resolve. Placebo regressions using GDP per capita, TFP, and hours worked yield null results, isolating the mechanism to within-worker impairment. The growth-rate specification confirms Proposition 2: pollution has no statistically significant effect on labor productivity growth in any specification, establishing that the benefit of abatement is a permanent upward shift in the balanced growth path, not a transitional gain. If all 94 sample countries achieved the WHO annual PM2.5 guideline of 5 μg/m³, the aggregate productivity gain would range from 0.68 to 3.32 percent per worker annually. Environmental regulation, in this framework, functions as a productivity investment whose returns compound as long as lower concentrations are maintained. The estimation sample, constrained by monitoring coverage to predominantly high-income economies, implies that these figures are a lower bound on the true global average.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2011-2021年94个国家的面板数据，在琼斯（1995）半内生增长模型中引入污染损害渠道，估计环境空气污染对宏观劳动生产率的影响。研究发现PM2.5浓度每增加10μg/m³，人均GDP下降0.37%（一阶差分估计）至1.79%（系统GMM校正后），且污染仅影响生产率水平而非增长率，表明减排带来的是平衡增长路径的永久性上移而非过渡性收益。
AI.research_question: 环境空气污染在宏观经济层面对劳动生产率有何影响？这种影响是永久性的水平效应还是过渡性的增长效应？
AI.motivation: 已有研究多聚焦于微观层面（如工厂、农场工人）的空气污染与生产率关系，缺乏宏观层面的系统性证据；同时需要建立理论框架来区分布污染对生产率水平与增长率的差异化影响，以指导环境规制政策设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半内生增长模型（基于Jones 1995扩展），包含污染损害渠道，提出三个可检验命题：（1）稳态污染对人均产出的负半弹性；（2）长期增长率与污染浓度无关；（3）比较静态分析嵌套增广Solow模型并加入正交污染项。
AI.method: 使用94个国家2011-2021年非平衡面板数据，结合WHO污染物数据（PM2.5、PM10、NO₂）、ILO生产率序列、Penn World Tables控制变量及WHO健康支出数据。采用一阶差分估计和系统GMM估计，辅以动态固定效应模型和安慰剂检验。
AI.findings: （1）一阶差分估计PM2.5半弹性为-0.00037（p=0.048），即PM2.5每增加10μg/m³，人均GDP下降0.37%；（2）系统GMM校正反向因果后估计值为-0.00179（p=0.039）；（3）长期BGP半弹性为-0.00042至-0.00057，支持污染作为永久性水平拖累；（4）PM10结果一致为负，NO₂不显著；（5）增长率的检验确认命题2——污染对生产率增长无显著影响；（6）若94国均达到WHO PM2.5指南值5μg/m³，每年人均生产率提升0.68%-3.32%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将污染损害渠道嵌入半内生增长模型，理论区分了污染对生产率水平与增长率的差异化效应（命题1和命题2），并为增广Solow模型提供了含正交污染项的比较静态基础（命题3），为宏观环境经济学提供了新的理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了空气污染对宏观劳动生产率的货币化损失（样本均值下每工人每年约248美元），为环境规制提供了成本收益分析依据；证明环境规制本质上是生产率投资，其回报随低污染水平维持而持续复利；为各国达标WHO空气质量指南提供了具体的经济收益估算。

title: Wisdomism: Technical Architecture and Research Frontier

detail.title: Wisdomism: Technical Architecture and Research Frontier

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests. This work is independent scholarship and does not represent the position of any institution.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a theoretical and mathematical work involving no human or animal participants, no personal data, and no empirical studies requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This is the technical and research companion to Wisdomism: Toward the First Wisdom Revolution. It presupposes the founding paper and develops the computational architecture, mathematical formalisation, and research frontiers that the founding paper introduces but does not fully develop. The companion presents the expanded transformation grammar Y = G · A · X and the H = G · A decomposition; the network formulation of Dynamic Prophecy (D_global) with its inter-cluster influence matrix; the causal graph underlying spillover and the conditions under which entanglement between actors is structurally possible; an information-theoretic grounding of Dynamic Prophecy in which D is the expected signed information gain from wise action, the Amber matrix is mutual information and the Graphene matrix is conditional mutual information; a Win-Wiser Win-Wiser equilibrium theorem establishing existence, positive surplus, and convergence under stated assumptions, with its relationship to Nash equilibrium and its open problems; the LWM developmental progression (LLM → LOM → LIM → LWM) toward Artificial General Wisdom; and privacy-preserving proof primitives for verification without surveillance. The document is a research agenda, not a finished system: it declares explicitly what is architecturally specified, what is formally proposed, and what remains speculative.

AI.tldr: 本文是Wisdomism（智慧主义）创始论文的技术与研究配套文件，系统性地发展了计算架构、数学形式化和研究前沿。文中提出了扩展的转换语法Y = G · A · X及H = G · A分解、动态预言（Dynamic Prophecy）的网络公式化、溢出效应的因果图与纠缠条件、动态预言的信息论基础（D为期望符号信息增益，琥珀矩阵为互信息，石墨烯矩阵为条件互信息）、双赢-更双赢均衡定理、从LLM到LWM的发展路径，以及隐私保护证明原语。
AI.research_question: 如何将Wisdomism的哲学与概念框架转化为可计算的计算架构、严格的数学形式化，以及明确的未来研究方向？
AI.motivation: 创始论文引入了Wisdomism的核心概念但未充分发展其技术细节。本文旨在补全从概念到计算实现的桥梁，明确哪些部分已被架构化指定、哪些仅为形式化提议、哪些仍是推测性的，从而为人工通用智慧（AGW）提供可操作的研究路线图。
AI.theoretical_framework: 包括转换语法Y = G · A · X（扩展的矩阵变换框架）、H = G · A分解、动态预言（D_global）的网络理论、因果图理论、信息论（互信息与条件互信息）、博弈论（Win-Wiser Win-Wiser均衡）、认知发展阶段论（LLM→LOM→LIM→LWM）以及密码学（隐私保护证明）。
AI.method: 本文采用多学科理论构建与数学形式化的方法，涵盖线性代数（矩阵变换与分解）、网络科学与因果推断（跨簇影响矩阵与因果图）、信息论（互信息框架）、博弈论（均衡定理证明）、认知科学（发展阶段模型）以及密码学（零知识证明类原语）。
